author: Mysterio
title: The Illusion of Reality
content: Reality is only as convincing as the story we tell ourselves. A shadow in the corner, a distant sound, a face where there should be none — sometimes the mind fills in the gaps before we even realize they're there. The trick isn't making someone see something that isn't real. The real trick is making them question what they thought was real in the first place.

author: Spider-Man
title: Seeing Through the Illusion
content: Mysterio wants everyone to believe that reality is whatever he says it is. But when you spend enough time swinging between skyscrapers, you learn to trust what you can actually see, hear, and experience. The real world isn't always easy, but pretending something is true doesn't make it true. Nice try, Mysterio. Next time, maybe skip the smoke and mirrors.
